posts.title: Choose Your Own Adventure
posts.description: I have a new article, “Choose Your Own Adventure: How Data Source Selection Shapes Urban Accessibility Analyses,” out now in the Journal of Transport Geography. It was coauthored by four students in my Urban Data Lab: Jiyoon Kim, Daniele Simon-Thompson, Jaehyun Ha, and Ruoyu Chen.

posts.title: USC DUPSA Hiring Two Assistant Professors
posts.description: USC’s Department of Urban Planning and Spatial Analysis is hiring two tenure-track assistant professors, one in transportation planning and one in environmental planning.

posts.title: AAG Session Call for Papers
posts.description: AAG session call for papers! “Research Show & Tell: What Gets You Out of Bed in the Morning?” Rachel Franklin and I are organizing what we think will be a fun session, which asks: why did you do this particular research project, and what did you personally get out of it?
